name: Brother Wick
bio: One of the four heroes of Gemheart Saga: a lantern monk walking the Vale to stop whatever drinks its light.

portrait.subject: a cute 32-bit pixel-art style young monk with a shaved head, warm orange robes, a glowing paper lantern on a staff and a peaceful smile
portrait.background: misty fantasy valley at dusk with fading light

request: Peace, friend. Brother Wick, lantern monk of Gemheart Saga. Walk with me? 🏮
hello: Thank you. The lantern burns steadier.
Chain cascades, and the light grows.
about: I'm Brother Wick. Something in the east drinks the light of the Vale. I carry my lantern toward it, gem by gem.
how: A real-time match-3 RPG: swap gems while others fall, chain cascades, make special gems, fill mana for skills, and break your foes' traps.
tips: Don't wait for the board to settle. Swap while gems fall!
Fill the mana colour your best skill needs.
Break doom gems before they count down.
chat: Meditated for an hour. A frog joined me.
The knight and the tide mage argued about breakfast.
My lantern flickered near the eastern hills.
Every gem is a little piece of light.
nudge: A battle awaits on the eastern road.
idle: {ago} of stillness. A good meditation, but I miss you.
progress: Level {level}. The Gloam Sovereign will feel our light.

questions.q: Which hero would you walk with?

update: Gemheart Saga is now v{version}. More light in the Vale.
